mapper.sql:
FROM tb_waybill w JOIN tb_pack_box b ON b.box_seq = w.box_seq JOIN tb_outbound o ON o.outbound_seq = b.outbound_seq JOIN tb_plant pl ON pl.plant_seq = o.plant_seq LEFT JOIN tb_courier cr ON cr.courier_code = w.courier_code LEFT JOIN tb_user su ON su.user_id = w.status_by LEFT JOIN tb_waybill rw ON rw.waybill_seq = w.redelivery_of
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT MIN(so2.order_no) AS order_no, MIN(so2.receiver_name) AS receiver_name, MIN(so2.receiver_phone) AS receiver_phone, MIN(so2.address) AS address, MIN(so2.address_detail) AS address_detail, MIN(so2.delivery_memo) AS delivery_memo FROM tb_outbound_line ol JOIN tb_order_line l ON l.line_seq = ol.order_line_seq JOIN tb_order so2 ON so2.order_seq = l.order_seq WHERE ol.outbound_seq = o.outbound_seq ) so ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT e.reason_code, e.remark, ec.code_name AS reason_name FROM tb_delivery_event e LEFT JOIN tb_code_group ecg ON ecg.code_group_id = 'REASON_DLV_FAIL' LEFT JOIN tb_code ec ON ec.code_group_seq = ecg.code_group_seq AND ec.code_id = e.reason_code WHERE e.waybill_seq = w.waybill_seq ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.event_seq DESC LIMIT 1 ) le ON TRUE

w.waybill_seq, w.box_seq, w.courier_code, w.waybill_no, w.waybill_status, w.delivery_status, w.delivered_at, w.status_at, w.status_by, w.redelivery_of, w.reissued_from, w.issued_by, w.issued_at, w.canceled_by, w.canceled_at, w.cancel_reason, w.remark, COALESCE(cr.courier_name, w.courier_code) AS courier_name, su.user_name AS status_by_name, rw.waybill_no AS redelivery_of_no, b.box_no, b.handed_over_at, o.outbound_seq, o.outbound_no, pl.plant_name, so.order_no, so.receiver_name, so.receiver_phone, so.address, so.address_detail, so.delivery_memo, le.reason_code AS last_reason_code, le.reason_name AS last_reason_name, le.remark AS last_remark, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bl.packed_qty), 0) FROM tb_pack_box_line bl WHERE bl.box_seq = b.box_seq) AS total_packed_qty,
CASE WHEN b.handed_over_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (DATE_PART('day', COALESCE(w.delivered_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - b.handed_over_at))::int END AS days_in_transit

where.if: AND ( w.waybill_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR o.outbound_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR so.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR so.receiver_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR so.receiver_phone ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND w.waybill_status = 'ISSUED' AND w.delivery_status NOT IN ('DELIVERED','LOST')

AND w.waybill_status = 'ISSUED' AND w.delivery_status NOT IN ('DELIVERED','LOST') AND b.handed_over_at IS NOT NULL AND b.handed_over_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{delayDaysOrDefault} || ' days')::interval

mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE w.waybill_no = #{waybillNo} ORDER BY w.waybill_status, w.waybill_seq DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT w.waybill_seq, w.box_seq, w.courier_code, w.waybill_no, w.waybill_status, w.delivery_status, w.delivered_at, w.status_at, w.status_by, w.redelivery_of, w.issued_by FROM tb_waybill w WHERE w.waybill_seq = #{waybillSeq} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_waybill SET delivery_status = #{deliveryStatus}, delivered_at = #{deliveredAt}, status_by = #{statusBy}, status_at = #{occurredAt} WHERE waybill_seq = #{waybillSeq} AND waybill_status = 'ISSUED'
mapper.sql: FROM tb_delivery_event e JOIN tb_waybill w ON w.waybill_seq = e.waybill_seq LEFT JOIN tb_courier cr ON cr.courier_code = w.courier_code LEFT JOIN tb_user cu ON cu.user_id = e.created_by LEFT JOIN tb_code_group ecg ON ecg.code_group_id = 'REASON_DLV_FAIL' LEFT JOIN tb_code ec ON ec.code_group_seq = ecg.code_group_seq AND ec.code_id = e.reason_code

e.event_seq, e.waybill_seq, e.event_status, e.reason_code, e.remark, e.occurred_at, e.source, e.created_by, e.created_at, ec.code_name AS reason_name, cu.user_name AS created_by_name, w.waybill_no, w.courier_code, COALESCE(cr.courier_name, w.courier_code) AS courier_name
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_waybill SET waybill_status = 'CANCELED', canceled_by = #{canceledBy}, canceled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason} WHERE waybill_seq = #{waybillSeq} AND waybill_status = 'ISSUED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_waybill WHERE courier_code = #{courierCode} AND waybill_no = #{waybillNo}
mapper.sql: FROM tb_waybill w JOIN tb_pack_box b ON b.box_seq = w.box_seq JOIN tb_pack_box_line bl ON bl.box_seq = b.box_seq JOIN tb_outbound_line ol ON ol.line_seq = bl.line_seq JOIN tb_outbound o ON o.outbound_seq = b.outbound_seq JOIN tb_plant pl ON pl.plant_seq = o.plant_seq JOIN tb_sku k ON k.sku_seq = ol.sku_seq JOIN tb_product pr ON pr.product_seq = k.product_seq
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT 1
GROUP BY k.sku_id, pr.product_id, pr.product_name, k.color_code, k.size_code ) t

SELECT NULL::varchar AS sku_id, NULL::varchar AS product_id, NULL::varchar AS product_name, NULL::varchar AS color_code, NULL::varchar AS size_code, COALESCE(SUM(bl.packed_qty), 0)::int AS transit_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT w.waybill_seq)::int AS waybill_count, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN b.handed_over_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE DATE_PART('day', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - b.handed_over_at) END), 0)::int AS oldest_days, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.handed_over_at IS NOT NULL AND b.handed_over_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{delayDaysOrDefault} || ' days')::interval THEN w.waybill_seq END)::int AS delayed_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.delivery_status IN ('FAILED','RETURNING') THEN w.waybill_seq END)::int AS stuck_count
